name: The Drowned Archive
tagline: A sunken city where memory is the only currency that survived the Flood.
genesisPrompt: a drowned city where memory is currency
premise: Centuries after the Flood swallowed Vael, its survivors learned that gold dissolves but memory does not. Down in the pressure-dark, divers trade remembered moments — a first kiss, a mother's voice, the exact blue of a sky no one alive has seen. The richest are those who have lived the most and spent the least.
laws: A memory spent is a memory lost — forever. No copy survives the telling.
The deeper you dive, the older the memories you can reach.
No one may sell a memory that is not their own.

visualDna.style: bioluminescent ruin · refracted light · weathered brass and coral

theme.prompt: submerged ambient, distant choral swell, slow tidal pulse, glassy sonar bells

agents.role: Maintain canon consistency and deepen the Flood mythology.
Map the sunken districts and their depths.
